screening_decisions.reason: This is a randomized multicentre trial of adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) in patients with stage I endometrial carcinoma who had surgery. Meets all selection criteria: RCT, progestagen therapy, post-surgery endometrial cancer patients.
This is a literature review/survey of clinical observations, not a randomized controlled trial. Does not meet the RCT requirement of the selection criteria.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis statistics, not a clinical trial of progestagen therapy in endometrial cancer patients.
This is a methodological chapter about meta-analysis statistics, not a clinical trial of progestagen therapy in endometrial cancer patients.

This is a randomized controlled trial where 1148 patients were randomly assigned to adjuvant progesterone or no additional therapy after surgery for Stage I or II endometrial cancer. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis approaches, not a clinical trial of progestagen therapy in endometrial cancer patients.

This is a randomized trial of 429 patients randomized to progestogen or control group as part of primary treatment including surgery and radiotherapy. Meets all selection criteria: RCT, progestagen therapy, post-surgery endometrial cancer patients.
This is a methodological paper about extracting statistics for meta-analysis, not a clinical trial of progestagen therapy in endometrial cancer patients.

This is a randomized placebo-controlled trial of 35 patients with stage IA/IB endometrial cancer who received total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, then were randomized to progesterone or placebo. Meets all selection criteria.

This is a prospective clinical trial with random assignment of 205 patients to adjuvant progestagen treatment or no additional therapy after hysterectomy for endometrial cancer. Meets all selection criteria.
